w:r.w:t: One Ummah is a UK Muslim charity. This dashboard is the admin portal for managing WhatsApp donation campaigns, donors, QR codes, broadcasts, and analytics. It connects to a Spring Boot backend API.
React Query (TanStack Query) — for all API calls and caching
Ant Design or Material UI — component library
The API uses JWT Bearer tokens. The login endpoint returns an accessToken and refreshToken.
Store accessToken in memory (React context or Zustand) — NEVER in localStorage
Store refreshToken in an HTTP-only cookie if possible, otherwise in memory
Add token to every request: Authorization: Bearer {accessToken}
When any API returns 401, call POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with the refreshToken
On logout, call POST /api/v1/auth/logout then clear all stored tokens
All responses follow the same structure. Always read response.data to get the payload.
Always use response.data.content for the list items and response.data.totalElements for pagination.
After login, the response includes the user's permissions array. Use this to show or hide UI elements. Never rely only on role name — always check specific permissions.
Full access to all screens and actions

Donor list and donor profile only

Do not redirect if already logged in — check token on page load
